why.org_c:finding:04083: Critical KEV vulnerability on an internet-facing or high-exposure asset.

reasoning: We identified open findings prioritizing KEV and high-exposure assets that could pose a risk to the crown jewel database. Due to limited paths from internet-facing assets to the warehouse, addressing the top KEV finding mitigates the primary entry point.

input.sql:
SELECT f.id AS finding, a.hostname, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev, f.status,
       (SELECT json_agg(t.dst) FROM edges t WHERE t.type = 'CAN_REACH' AND t.src = a.id) as reaches
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.dst = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON a.id = e_on.src
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON v.id = e_of.dst
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
LIMIT 20;

SELECT f.id, a.hostname, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev,
       (SELECT json_agg(e.src) FROM edges e WHERE e.dst = a.id AND e.type = 'EXPOSES') as exposed_from
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.dst = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON a.id = e_on.src
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON v.id = e_of.dst
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true;

SELECT f.id, a.hostname, v.cve, v.cvss, v.epss
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.dst = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON a.id = e_on.src
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON v.id = e_of.dst
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND a.id IN (
  SELECT dst FROM edges WHERE type = 'CAN_REACH' AND src IN (
    SELECT dst FROM edges WHERE type = 'EXPOSES'
  )
)
ORDER BY v.cvss DESC, v.epss DESC
LIMIT 10;
